messages:
Morgan: Heads up — brought up q8_int8-ranker-v2 on staging and seeing ~5pt NDCG@10 drop on short queries vs float baseline. Notified because it's worrying. /cc @Tara @Liam :eyes:

Tara: rough numbers? sample size? is MRR affected?

Morgan: quick first pass: ndcg@10 down 0.05 (float 0.72 -> int8 0.67) on short-queries subset (n=1.2k). MRR stable within noise. full eval running.

Liam: can you paste the eval command? want to reproduce locally

Morgan: sure:
```
python -m evals.rerank --model q8_int8-ranker-v2 --candidates-path s3://rankbench/staging/cands.jsonl --queries queries/short-queries.jsonl --metrics ndcg@10,mrr --seed 42
```

InfraBot: job 4567 queued -> running on k8s-cluster-staging (nodepool-gpu-rtx). Logs: https://ci/reports/4567

Ana: did we change tokenizer or preproc? padding/truncation differences often bite in int8 PTQ.

Morgan: no tokenizer change in model recipe. But candidate generation for staging snapshot had been re-shuffled yesterday (candidate order changed). Could be tie-breaking differences.

Sam: try re-eval with prefix cache disabled (that can change KV alignment subtlely in quant builds).

Morgan: trying now, will post delta.

[~6m later]

Morgan: quick follow-up: disabling prefix cache recovered ~0.03 NDCG (now 0.70). Still ~0.02 below float baseline. So caching interaction explains some but not all.

Tara: do we have examples where rank order flips? any human-inspectable failures?

Morgan: yes, attaching two examples inline (orig top3 vs int8 top3):
1) Query: "how to reset api key" — float top3: [docA, docB, docC], int8 top3: [docB, docA, docD]
2) Query: "css center div" — float: [docX, docY, docZ], int8: [docX, docZ, docY]

Liam: likely small score scale compression due to quantization + layernorm folding. Can we check raw scores distribution? run `bin/score_hist.py --model q8_int8-ranker-v2 --queries queries/short-queries.jsonl`

Morgan: ran it. float scores mean 2.1 sigma 0.9; int8 mean 1.9 sigma 0.85 (shift/scale). I can try calibrating output rescale in postproc.

Sam: try per-batch rescale trick used in prior PTQ runs: multiply logits by 1.05 before softmax. Could be a band-aid for now.

Morgan: did that — ndcg@10 goes to 0.71, mrr unchanged.

Ana: we should add a small holdout of short queries to the onboarding checklist to catch this earlier. Also check tokenization parity between offline eval harness and prod-serving tokenizer (esp invisible whitespace).

Morgan: agreed. I'll open a PR to add short-query holdout and to record tokenizer hashes in the model metadata.

Tara: also let's run a larger sampling (n=10k) for stability and compute p-value for the ndcg delta.

Morgan: kicking off 10k job now (job 4570). Will report tomorrow. Thanks all :thumbsup:

Liam: sounds good. if job fails ping me and i'll grab logs.

Morgan: ping me for any quick reproductions; thanks :party_parrot:
